race.comment: EXTINGUISH (5) has just missed in her two runs back but is at her top now and can put it all together. Has been freshened with 5 weeks in-between and is unbeaten over this trip. Ready. ROGUE WARRIOR (9) brings across some solid Vic formlines and is another that is ready to put it all together. Will be tested by the draw but gets a key booking in Holder. NICISH (1) was strong to the line in her first look at the mile last start. Unsure why it took them so long to get there but she's here now and is should be right there again from the inside alley. TYUSIX (10) made strong late inroads to finish a close fifth when resuming last start. Gets in well again with the 3kg claim and can give this a big shake without surprising. Must include. AUSTRALIA FOREVER (7) possesses a strong turn of foot and should be suited with a rise to the mile. Watch for her bursting through.
